tests.title: A deposit adds to the balance
A transfer moves money between wallets
Lists a wallet's transactions, newest first
Can't spend more than the balance
Frozen wallets can't send or receive

bugs.why: a transfer takes the money out of the sender before checking the recipient, so a transfer to a missing or frozen wallet loses the money
bugs.fix: Look up and check both wallets (and the balance) before recording either side.

edits.fixed:
source = wallet_or_fail(from_id)
    target = wallet_or_fail(to_id)
    active_or_fail(source)
    active_or_fail(target)
    if source["balance"] < amount:
        raise WalletError(409, "Insufficient funds")

    store.record(source, "transfer_out", amount, at, target["id"])
    store.record(target, "transfer_in", amount, at, source["id"])
edits.buggy:
source = wallet_or_fail(from_id)
    active_or_fail(source)
    if source["balance"] < amount:
        raise WalletError(409, "Insufficient funds")
    store.record(source, "transfer_out", amount, at, to_id)

    target = wallet_or_fail(to_id)
    active_or_fail(target)
    store.record(target, "transfer_in", amount, at, source["id"])

bugs.why: the transfer URL is registered as transfer, so POST /api/transfers gets a 404
bugs.fix: The path is transfers (plural), as in the README.

bugs.why: the transactions URL captures <str:wallet>, but the view takes wallet_id, so every request fails before the view runs
bugs.fix: Capture <str:wallet_id>, like the other wallet URLs.

bugs.why: the view reads the filter from ?kind= instead of ?type=, so the type filter is ignored
